# Fenley Menelas

> Independent web designer and developer building fast, multilingual websites and web apps in English, Spanish and French. Custom builds start at $1,000; the ongoing care membership is $50/month.

Fenley Menelas is a software engineer based in Haiti, serving clients across the United States, Canada, the Dominican Republic and Haiti. Every project is AI-assisted and human-reviewed: Next.js and React front ends, WordPress and Shopify builds, technical SEO, accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA), performance work and analytics. Sites can ship in three languages — English, Spanish and French — with translation built into the structure from the first draft rather than pasted on at the end.

Typical reply time: within 24 hours, in English, Spanish or French.

- [How I build](https://fenleymenelas.com/build): Build principles — speed, audience-first design, shared stakes, a foundation made to grow
- [Skills](https://fenleymenelas.com/skills): Project management, CMS and e-commerce, custom applications, cloud infrastructure, AI
- [About](https://fenleymenelas.com/about): Background, almost a decade of shipping web, mobile and desktop products
- [Contact](https://fenleymenelas.com/contact): Project enquiry form, email, phone, WhatsApp, LinkedIn profile

## Languages

The whole site is available in three languages. English lives at the root URL; Spanish and French are path-prefixed. Every localized page declares its own `rel="canonical"` plus `hreflang` alternates for all three languages and `x-default`.

- English (x-default): https://fenleymenelas.com
- Español: https://fenleymenelas.com/es
- Français: https://fenleymenelas.com/fr

Localized equivalents exist for every page above, e.g. https://fenleymenelas.com/es/services and https://fenleymenelas.com/fr/services.
